body.purpose: All interface copy, inputs, and buttons. Schibsted Grotesk — a warm grotesque close to Claude's Styrene.

label.purpose: Stat labels, section notes — small, tracked, uppercase.

shadows.name: control-lift
shadows.purpose: Buttons and the Google button at rest.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: All entrances: fade-ups, question turn-in, feedback, pulse.

motion.name: dur-pulse
motion.purpose: Single scale pulse on the Total Earnings value.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single call to action — submit answer, log in, create account.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #D97757; color: #1F1E1C; font: 600 1rem/1 Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 13px 22px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.2); transition: background .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease, transform .05s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #E08B6D; box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #D97757; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .55; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Google Sign-In
components.description: OAuth entry — the one deliberately bright element, kept pristine white.
components.css: .ds-btn-google { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; width: 100%; background: #ffffff; color: #1F1E1C; font: 600 1rem/1 Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 13px; border: none; border-radius: 12px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.2); transition: box-shadow .15s ease, transform .05s ease; } .ds-btn-google:hover { box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.35); } .ds-btn-google:active { transform: scale(.985); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Email, password, and answer fields — inset on their surface, coral focus.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #363532; color: #F4F3EE; font: 400 1rem/1.4 Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 13px 16px; border: 1px solid #43413C; border-radius: 12px; outline: none; transition: border-color .15s ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #A8A5A0; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #D97757; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(217,119,87,.25); }

components.name: Stat Chip
components.description: Compact metric chips above the question card.
components.css: .ds-stat { background: #2E2D2B; border: 1px solid #43413C; border-radius: 12px; padding: 8px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-end; gap: 2px; } .ds-stat-label { font: 500 .72rem/1.3 Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .06em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #A8A5A0; } .ds-stat-value { font: 600 1.1rem/1.2 'Source Serif 4', Georgia, serif; color: #D97757; }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: Login / Sign Up switcher on the auth card.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 4px; background: #363532; border: 1px solid #43413C; border-radius: 12px; padding: 4px; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; padding: 10px; font: 600 .95rem/1 Schibsted Grotesk, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #A8A5A0; background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s ease, color .15s ease; } .ds-tab:hover { color: #F4F3EE; } .ds-tab.active { background: #D97757; color: #1F1E1C; }

narrative.overview: Math Points is a dark adaptation of Claude.ai's visual identity: warm charcoal surfaces that never go pure black, a serif voice for the arithmetic itself, and a single coral accent reserved for action and earning. The interface reads like a quiet desk lamp over paper — every surface is a warm neutral, borders are hairline, and the only saturated thing in the room is the coral that marks what you can do and what you have earned. Motion is restrained: entrances fade up gently, the question slides in as if turned over, and a correct answer gives a single quiet pulse rather than a celebration.
keyCharacteristics: Warm charcoal neutrals with a faint brown undertone; no pure black, no cool grays
Serif display (Source Serif 4) for the question and brand; Inter for every label and control
One coral accent (Claude's #D97757) used only for primary action and the points that earn
Hairline borders + soft warm shadows for depth; flat surfaces at rest
Gentle authored motion: fade-up entrances, question turn-in, a single pulse on earnings

rules.name: The One Coral Rule
rules.body: Coral covers less than 5% of any screen at rest. Its rarity is what makes earning read as an event.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; the only response to state is a border-color shift, a 1px translate on press, or a soft hover shadow on primary actions.

dos: Do set the question in the serif display face — it is the product's voice.
Do reserve coral for action and earnings; muted warm neutrals carry everything else.
Do keep motion gentle: fade-ups under 0.5s, a single pulse on earning, nothing that bounces or spins.
Do use hairline borders plus a soft warm shadow for card depth.
donts: Don't use pure black, cool grays, or blue-tinted darks — the palette is warm charcoal.
Don't add gradient text, glassmorphism, or glowing accents.
Don't animate the question continuously; it enters once and rests.
Don't let coral cover more than ~5% of any screen at rest.
